./scripts/shizuku-starter.sh

./scripts/setup-termux-n8n.sh

./scripts/start-n8n.sh
./scripts/stop-n8n.sh
```

Generate local SSL certificates for secure HTTPS API access:
```bash
./scripts/generate-local-ssl.sh
